title: Lulu's Beef & Broccoli Fried Rice
ingredients: Beef & marinade: 500g lean steak, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp dark soy, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp cornstarch
Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tbsp coconut sugar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 0.5 tsp each Chinese 5-spice & white pepper, 2 tbsp water
5 cloves garlic minced & 2 tsp ginger paste
To serve: 4 fried eggs, chilli oil, sesame seeds
steps: Marinate sliced beef with oyster sauce, dark soy, baking soda, cornstarch, and white pepper for 15 minutes.
Cover broccoli with boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry beef for 2 to 3 minutes until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and spring onion whites in oil on high heat for 1 minute before adding rice.
Toss in rice, broccoli, and mixed sauce, stir-frying for 2 minutes until hot and well coated.
Return beef to pan, toss until heated through, stir in green spring onions, and serve with fried egg.
